purpose: City-specific discovery and bounded verification of an official cadastral/parcel source for İnegöl, Türkiye; this research packet is not source integration or admission.
name: İnegöl

queries.query: Inegol Turkey official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS parcel service
queries.result: Found the official TKGM Parsel Sorgulama service, the İnegöl municipality Kent Rehberi and E-İmar portals, and the İnegöl district cadastral unit. The public search results did not expose a documented anonymous parcel geometry API.

queries.query: İnegöl kadastro parsel sorgu resmi harita tapu kadastro
queries.result: First-party results identify İnegöl Belediyesi Kent Rehberi and E-İmar as public local GIS/planning interfaces, TKGM Parsel Sorgulama as the official national parcel service, and the İnegöl Kaymakamlığı İlçe Kadastro Birimi as the district cadastral office.

registryBasis: A local cadastral custodian and public local map/planning procedures are evidenced: the first-party İnegöl Kaymakamlığı page lists the İlçe Kadastro Birimi and its parcel-related duties, while İnegöl Belediyesi publishes the Kent Rehberi and E-İmar interfaces with parcel/ada search. This is custodian and public-service evidence, not a qualified runtime adapter.

officialSources.operator: İnegöl Kaymakamlığı İlçe Kadastro Birimi / TKGM
officialSources.scope: First-party district page identifying the local cadastral unit and its statutory duties, including parcel display/application and cadastral-map maintenance.
